steps.label: Term 1 Test
steps.content:
Year 6 Scratch

Term 1 Test

Year 6

  • First: 25 minutes of practice: cards, then two Scratch games.
  • Then: a 30-minute test on this website.
  • Topics: events, x and y, loops, variables, if blocks, costumes, messages, fixing bugs.
Think → Pair → ShareWhich Scratch blocks do you find hardest?Show the answer

Practise those cards most in the next 12 minutes.

steps.label: Revision Practice
steps.content:
Revision Practice

Think → Pair → ShareA repeat (4) loop has one change x by (10) inside. How much does x change?Show the answer

By 40: the block inside runs 4 times, 10 each time.

12 minutes. Read each script one block at a time. Stuck? Switch on I need help and press Walk me through it.

steps.label: Warm Up: Fix a Game
steps.content:
Warm Up: Fix a Game

Think → Pair → ShareHow do you find a bug?Show the answer

Play the game. Say what should happen and what does happen. Find the block that does the wrong thing. Change one thing, then test again.

Fix it

  • Play the game first.
  • Find the block that does the wrong thing.
  • Fix it, then press Check my project.

6 minutes. The test has a game like this to fix.

steps.label: Warm Up: Change a Game
steps.content:
Warm Up: Change a Game

Think → Pair → ShareYou need score to go up by 10, not 5. Which block do you change?Show the answer

The change [score] by block in the script that runs when the sprite is clicked. Change only its number.

Change it

  • Read the list of changes.
  • Find the script that does that part of the game.
  • Change one thing, then press Check my project.

7 minutes. The test has a game like this to change.

steps.label: How the Test Works
steps.content:
How the Test Works

Think → Pair → ShareIn Part 2, you fix a bug and press Check my project. One check is still red. What do you do?Show the answer

Read what the checker saw. Play that part of the game, fix the block, and press Check my project again. Your best check counts.

  • You have 30 minutes from when you press Start.
  • Part 1: read each script and press your answer.
  • Part 2: two Scratch games. Fix the bugs in one. Make changes to the other.
  • In Part 2, press Check my project. Your best check counts.
  • Your answers save automatically. Press Hand in when you finish.

steps.label: The Test
steps.content:
The Test

Think → Pair → ShareYou finish early. What should you do?Show the answer

Check every answer. Read each script again, one block at a time. Play your games again.

Wait until your teacher says the test is open. Then press the button, and press Start.
